topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Can you believe this? I just got this package, and it's clearly not for me. I mean, look at the name and everything – it's for the guy who lived here before me. This is such a hassle. Now I've got to figure out what to do with this thing, and who knows if they even got the right address anymore. And the worst part? I'm supposed to be heads down on a project today. Now I have to deal with this mess too. Why can't things just be simple for once?
